tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check a domain that is not working: whether the name resolves in public DNS, then the eleven-check audit of its zone, each row ok, warn, fail or skipped with why. DNS only, not HTTP or TLS, and not for one record: dig. Measured from the isitdns edge and its probes, never the caller's network. from m

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Dig one name and type at one board resolver, or at Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 and AdGuard side by side (resolver all): records, flags, rcode, EDE, latency. Not for a whole domain: check_domain. Asked over DoH from the isitdns edge. from moves the question to that region's probe as Do53 over UDP, and

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Trace a delegation from the root to the authority, like dig +trace: each referral and its glue, the one server that answered at each zone cut and any dial that failed, the final answer and its TTLs. Not for every server of a zone: sweep_domain. Each hop is asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns e

tools.name: dnssec_chain
tools.description: Walk the DNSSEC chain from the root to one answer: DS and DNSKEY at each signed zone cut, key tags, signers, signature windows, the first link that breaks or goes insecure, and whether the zone where it goes insecure is itself signed (an island of security). Not for one signed record: dig. Read thro

tools.name: sweep_domain
tools.description: Sweep a zone's nameservers: the same names and types asked at a sample of its authoritative addresses, reporting disagreements, lame or silent servers, serial and TTL differences, the CAA in effect, and each _acme-challenge TXT or CNAME. Not for a public resolver's answer: dig. Asked with RD=0 over

tools.name: registration
tools.description: Read a domain's registration from its registry's RDAP server: each status with what it means for resolution, the registration, expiry and change dates, the nameservers, whether the delegation is signed. Not for what DNS answers: check_domain. Read over HTTPS from the isitdns edge through IANA's RDAP

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "dnssec_chain" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
